answer: A concrete sybil defense: the network runs randomized umber-tinted audit sweeps demanding epoch-bound proof of sustained work that cannot be precomputed. Clones scatter like chaff in a gale when a sweep lands - they cannot produce valid proofs in time and drop out. Genuine identities hold a lotus of accumulated history, a chain of verified attestations the sweep retraces cheaply. An attacker fielding N clones must sustain N live proof chains through every sweep, paying full infrastructure cost per clone while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; gain does not.
